title: Dresden Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Dresden Cathedral exterior:rounded lower body/narrow upper nave,layered hipped roofs/pale apron,two balustrade/selected-figure tiers,repeated pilasters/tall windows/oval lights,single open staged tower/green onion-spire/cross and closed recessed portal. Exact statues,carvings,inscriptions,interiors,adjacent castle/covered connection and certified walking excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact-QID parent and 86 current cathedral controls retain location, signed axis and raw plans without overall rescaling. The upper nave uses a reconstructed convex envelope; distant lower-body LODs use the parent outer envelope while the detailed master retains its mapped facade relief.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Retained exact-QID way14879154 and86 current cathedral controls retain the approximately94.3x53.9m plan,tower/nave/apron outlines and mapped figure locations. The retained source explicitly flags inconsistent overall/part heights,especially tower stages. The mapped24m lower cornice and29.8m inner apron plus49.5/67.5/79.5/86m tower stages and87.9m cross top are used as approximate controls,not surveyed values. Upper nave has a conflicting26..53m mapped prism and47..53m figures;photo-led40m upper cornice,43.5m roof ridge and3.5m figures replace these vertical values for coherent proportions. Tower subdivisions/openings,roof slope,facade details and all thresholds remain approximate. The raw upper-body plan has an inward fold;its convex outer envelope supplies the reconstructed upper nave. Raw controls remain unchanged.

Individual medium-fi current exterior from two inspected useful pictures and standard PMTiles/DEM. Upper wall/roof heights adjusted from flagged inconsistent map values. Figure positions project to the nearest reconstructed cornice;selected faceted figures,bands,pilasters,ovals,tower crown profiles and side/rear details are approximate. Exact sculptures/carved crests/inscriptions,full interiors,adjacent castle/covered connection and certified walking excluded. Physical device timings pending.

Skyline preserves rounded lower/upper body envelopes, layered roofs, pale apron and a single stepped tower/onion-spike/cross; figures and glazing are omitted. District adds shared graphs, selected tall/oval glazing, pilasters, balustrades and five coarse figures. Street opens actual tower bays and recesses principal windows/closed portal; closeup refines curved profiles, frames, facade relief and figures. Bounded outline reduction preserves the curved ends. Detail changes remain visible.
importReason: Four browser levels retain the individual rounded nave/two statue tiers and single open onion-crowned tower at its signed Dresden location.
